subject.title: fix(msteams): add graphMediaFallback so group-chat file attachments reach the agent

question: Should OpenClaw accept `channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback` as a default-off group-chat attachment recovery option, or require this behavior to be folded into the broader Teams attachment repair?
rationale: The current patch is technically narrow after the scope fix, but adding a new operator-facing config option is a compatibility/product choice because it changes Graph call volume, permission expectations, and the support story for the canonical Teams attachment issue.

options.title: Accept narrow default-off option
options.body: Land this PR as the group-chat recovery path while keeping existing installs unchanged unless operators opt in and leaving channel URL repair to the broader PR.

options.title: Combine with broader Teams repair
options.body: Ask for one reconciled PR that handles group chats, channel team GUIDs, reply URLs, and fallback policy together before adding docs/config guidance.

options.title: Reject new config surface
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers prefer no new Teams fallback option and want automatic behavior or a different product surface instead.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow default-off option
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the group-chat recovery path while keeping existing installs unchanged unless operators opt in and leaving channel URL repair to the broader PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is a Teams plugin config/product tradeoff, and `steipete` has the strongest broad history signal under the Microsoft Teams plugin path.
